summary: BP p.l.c. furnished a Form 6-K containing a routine total voting rights notification as of 31 August 2026. The filing discloses issued ordinary share capital of 15,704,544,735 shares (excluding treasury shares) and 12,706,252 preference shares, with treasury shares of 781,768,259 not counted for voting or dividends. Total voting rights are reported at 15,709,627,235. This notification supports shareholder compliance with FCA Disclosure Guidance and Transparency Rules. No transaction, strategic corporate action, or special situation is involved, making the filing purely routine and not classifiable as a special situation.
